questionnaires.title: Dimensions of Anger Reactions (DAR-5)
questionnaires.description: A 5-item scale of anger reactions over the past four weeks — frequency, intensity, duration, aggression and interference with relationships (Dimensions of Anger Reactions).

frequency_5.label: None or almost none of the time
All or almost all of the time

items.text: Thinking about the past four weeks, select the response that best describes how often each statement applied to you.
I found myself getting angry at people or situations
When I got angry, I got really mad
When I got angry, I stayed angry
When I got angry at someone, I wanted to hit them
My anger prevented me from getting along with people as well as I’d have liked to
